questions.q:
India and Suriname held a Joint Commission meeting in 2026. Which of the following share a land border with Suriname?
1. Guyana
2. Brazil
3. Venezuela
4. French Guiana
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1, 3 and 4 only
1, 2 and 4 only
questions.e: Suriname, the smallest country of South America, lies on the Atlantic coast between Guyana to the west and French Guiana to the east, with Brazil to the south. Venezuela borders Guyana, not Suriname. The country was a Dutch colony, and a large share of its people descend from Indian indentured labourers, which is the basis of its cultural ties with India. Its capital is Paramaribo.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 129; neighbours are static

questions.q: 'Aarogya Maitri', deployed by India in Jamaica in 2026, refers to
o: a telemedicine network linking Indian hospitals with African universities
an agreement to export generic medicines at subsidised prices
a scholarship scheme for foreign students of Ayurveda
portable, modular healthcare units supplied by India to partner countries for emergencies
questions.e: Under the initiative India supplies compact medical cubes that can be carried by air or road and set up quickly as a field treatment facility with surgical and diagnostic equipment. It was announced as part of India's outreach to the Global South and has been sent to several countries hit by disaster or conflict. The deployment in Jamaica is an example of health diplomacy in the Caribbean.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 129; description is static

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs of places in the news in May 2026:
Place : State
1. Hasdeo-Arand forest : Chhattisgarh
2. Lipulekh Pass : Himachal Pradesh
3. Bhitarkanika Wildlife Sanctuary : Odisha
4. Kuno National Park : Madhya Pradesh
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
o: Only one pair
Only two pairs
Only three pairs
All four pairs
questions.e: Pairs 1, 3 and 4 are correct. Hasdeo-Arand is a dense, coal-bearing forest where a proposal to divert land and fell several lakh trees drew attention. Bhitarkanika, where a study found microplastics and heavy metals, is on the Odisha coast. Kuno received cheetahs from Botswana. Pair 2 is wrong: Lipulekh is in Pithoragarh district of Uttarakhand; Nepal objected to the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra being resumed through it.

questions.q: Oman's ports of Sohar and Salalah emerged in 2026 as lifelines for Indian exporters during disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. This is because
o: both lie inside the Persian Gulf but on its sheltered southern shore
both lie outside the strait, Sohar on the Gulf of Oman and Salalah on the Arabian Sea
Sohar lies on the Red Sea and Salalah on the Gulf of Aden
both are linked to the Mediterranean by a canal across the Arabian Peninsula
questions.e: The Strait of Hormuz joins the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman. A port on the Gulf of Oman or the open Arabian Sea can be reached without passing through it, and goods can then move overland to Gulf Cooperation Council markets. Sohar is on Oman's northern Batinah coast and Salalah in the far south, in Dhofar. Neither is on the Red Sea, and no such canal exists.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 129; port locations are static

questions.q: Fujairah, where a drone strike on an oil facility was reported in 2026, matters for energy security because it
o: stands at the narrowest point of the Strait of Hormuz
is the terminal of a pipeline that carries Gulf oil to the Red Sea
lies on the Gulf of Oman, so that oil piped to it can be shipped without passing through the Strait of Hormuz
is the largest oil field of the United Arab Emirates
questions.e: Fujairah is the only emirate whose coast is entirely on the Gulf of Oman, east of the strait. A pipeline from the Abu Dhabi fields brings crude to its terminal, and it is also a major bunkering and storage hub. That makes it one of the few outlets for Gulf oil that avoid Hormuz, and a target when tension rises. The pipeline to the Red Sea is Saudi Arabia's east-west line.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 129; location is static

questions.q: A 2026 study reported microplastics and toxic heavy metals in Bhitarkanika. Which one of the following is not correct about Bhitarkanika?
o: It is known for its population of saltwater crocodiles.
It lies on the Coromandel coast in the delta of the Godavari.
It is a Ramsar site.
It is a mangrove wetland.
questions.e: Bhitarkanika is in Kendrapara district of Odisha, in the delta of the Brahmani and the Baitarani, not the Godavari. It is India's second largest mangrove ecosystem after the Sundarbans, holds the country's largest population of estuarine crocodiles, and is a Ramsar wetland. The nearby Gahirmatha beach is a mass nesting site of olive ridley turtles. The mangroves of the Godavari delta are at Coringa in Andhra Pradesh.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 128; site facts are static

questions.q: The Musi river, for whose riverfront development guidelines were issued in 2026, is
o: a tributary of the Krishna that flows through Hyderabad
a tributary of the Godavari that flows through Warangal
a distributary of the Krishna that flows through Vijayawada
a tributary of the Tungabhadra that flows through Kurnool
questions.e: The Musi rises in the Ananthagiri hills, flows through Hyderabad dividing the old city from the new, and joins the Krishna in Nalgonda district. The Osman Sagar and Himayat Sagar reservoirs were built on it and its tributary after the flood of 1908. The Telangana government's project aims to clean and develop its heavily polluted urban stretch. The other choices name real rivers and towns of the region but wrong relationships.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 128; river facts are static

questions.q:
With reference to countries in the news in May 2026, consider the following statements:
1. Cyprus is a member of both the European Union and NATO.
2. Latvia shares land borders with both Lithuania and Poland.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
o: 1 only
2 only
Both 1 and 2
Neither 1 nor 2
questions.e: Neither is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: Cyprus joined the European Union in 2004 but is not a member of NATO, partly because of the division of the island and Turkey's position. Statement 2 is wrong: Latvia, a Baltic State with its capital at Riga, borders Estonia, Lithuania, Russia and Belarus, but not Poland, whose Baltic-side neighbour is Lithuania. Its long borders with Russia and Belarus explain its exposure to drones straying from the war in Ukraine.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 129; memberships and borders are static

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Light pollution was reported in 2026 to threaten astronomical observation in Chile's Atacama Desert.
Statement-II: Artificial light brightens the night sky and reduces the contrast needed to see faint celestial objects.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both are correct and the second explains the first. The Atacama's high altitude, dry air and cloudless nights make it one of the best sites in the world for observatories, which is why so many large telescopes stand there. Spill-over from mining, energy and urban projects scatters in the atmosphere, brightens the sky background and drowns out faint objects, so the quality that made the site precious is degraded. Hence the call to protect the darkest skies.
questions.s: Vision IAS p. 129; site conditions are static

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs of places in the news in May 2026:
Place : Country
1. Mayon volcano : Indonesia
2. Dukono volcano : Philippines
3. Hormozgan province : Iran
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
o: Only one pair
Only two pairs
All three pairs
None of the pairs
questions.e: Only pair 3 is correct. Hormozgan is Iran's southern province along the Strait of Hormuz, where strikes raised tension during the ceasefire. The two volcanoes are interchanged: Mayon, a near-perfect cone in Albay province on Luzon, is in the Philippines, where its eruption forced evacuations, and Dukono is on Halmahera in Indonesia's North Maluku province. Both lie on the Pacific Ring of Fire.
